scope: A direct tensor-support proof of the product-ray intersection fact already used in 141; no new family or independent review.
support_case_split: At positive shrink 0<t<1, any rank-three maximizing projector for a product ray psi must contain psi and have its range inside S_psi=span{psi, one-site orthogonal flips}. Suppose another product ray phi belongs to S_psi. After local rotation psi=|0000>, let phi=tensor_i(alpha_i|0>+beta_i|1>). If all alpha_i are nonzero, every weight-two coefficient beta_i beta_j product_{k!=i,j}alpha_k must vanish, hence at most one beta is nonzero. If at least one alpha_i=0, every nonzero computational coefficient has a 1 at that site. Membership in the weight<=1 subspace then forces exactly one zero alpha and all other beta_j=0. Thus distinct product rays can share the condition phi in S_psi only when they differ on exactly one physical factor, including a locally orthogonal factor.
intersection: For such distinct rays, isolate that one local factor. S_psi=(C^2 tensor |000>) direct-sum (|0> tensor E), S_phi=(C^2 tensor |000>) direct-sum (|phi_local> tensor E), where E is the three-dimensional span of the other three single-site flips. The |1> tensor E component forces any common vector in the second summands to be zero because phi_local has nonzero |1> coefficient; therefore their intersection is exactly C^2 tensor |000>, of dimension 2. No rank-three projector can have its range contained in both. All cutoff degeneracies are included because S is the entire top-plus-degenerate-second eigenspace.
boundaries: For negative shrink, first map both projectors by the same full-spinflip involution and apply the positive-shrink argument at p'=2-p; no claim that the negative-shrink product top eigenvector equals the input is made. At p=1 the whole output is I/16 and the intersection argument is inapplicable; at p=0 lower eigenvalue degeneracies permit other mixed-state equality cases.
conditional_application: Only if the entire still-unreviewed 121 uniform branch supplies strictness for every nonproduct pure input does this fact yield 141's mixed-state equality classification. It is not an independent proof of that strictness, new original-k3 family, formal review, or novelty claim.
process: The five 121 source corrections, separate 132/143 cadence findings and the 148 withdrawal remain; parent controls any review/source ordering.
